content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization at time of service. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review, and an appeal was already filed. There is no denial currently on the table and no valid path to obtain the missing auth. Resubmitting would risk a duplicate denial, and the balance cannot be billed to the patient because a provider auth failure is not patient-responsible. No action can properly progress this claim, so it should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
